data.rationale: The proposal gets the Careers → Openings → Country/Team/Time Type filters → Search sequence right with the correct filter parameters, but it treats the final step as an optional open-and-apply rather than a parameterized action that can be open or save, and it makes the job a parameter instead of the action, so the variable last step is only partly captured for automation.
